items.headline: Ryan Hopkins shines in his first start as Wisconsin trounces Rutgers 31-10
items.description: — Freshman Ryan Hopkins went 18 of 24 for 241 yards and three touchdowns in his first career start as Wisconsin bounced back from its worst loss of the season by defeating Rutgers 31-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Tommy Carr runs for two TDs, passes for one in Michigan's 28-21 win over Rutgers
items.description: — Michigan’s season-long offensive woes finally eased Saturday as freshman quarterback Tommy Carr led the Wolverines to 427 yards of offense in a 28-21 win over Rutgers.
